title: Scholerly
description: Scholerly is a modern tutoring platform that connects students with tutors. It offers a seamless user experience and robust backend infrastructure, featuring real-time notifications, secure role-based routing, and integrated payment functionality.
features: Modular Architecture: Clean service-controller separation following industry best practices.
JWT Authentication: Secure access for students, tutors, and admins using token-based auth.
Dual-Model Tutor Registration: Tutor info stored in both User and Tutor collections for flexibility.
Booking System: Students can book sessions with tutors.
SurjoPay Integration: Secure and simple online payments for booked sessions.
Admin Approval: Tutors require admin approval before becoming active.
Real-time Notifications: Socket.IO alerts for tutor registration, bookings, and approvals.
Advanced QueryBuilder: Flexible filtering and pagination support for list endpoints.

title: Chapters & Co.
description: Chapters & Co. is a feature-rich online bookshop built with a modern MERN stack. It includes secure authentication, a seller dashboard for book uploads, a user-friendly cart and payment system, and a responsive UI with smooth transitions.
features: Book Shop MERN Stack: Integrated with a MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js backend.
Modern UI/UX: Designed using Ant Design with Tailwind CSS for additional styling.
Authentication: User login and registration implemented.
Book Listings: Fetches book data from the backend.
Admin Dashboard: Allows sellers to post books to the database.
Cart & Payment System: Users can add books to the cart and proceed with checkout.
Fully Responsive: Optimized for all screen sizes.
Dark Overlay Hero Section: Beautiful introduction to the bookshop.

title: Event Planet
description: Event Planet is a comprehensive event management and booking platform designed for both organizers and attendees. It supports event creation, ticketing, reminders, chat, live support, and even an e-commerce shop for event-related merchandise.
features: Event Creation: Easily create and customize educational and training events with detailed information like type, date, time, and location.
Registration Management: Collect attendee information and manage registrations with an intuitive registration form.
Event Promotion: Share events via social media and email invitations to expand reach and increase attendance.
Participant Engagement: Boost interaction with live chat, polls, and Q&A features during events.
Real-time Analytics: Track event performance with live data on registrations, attendance, and engagement metrics.
Secure Payments: Enable online payments for paid events with a secure and streamlined process.
Responsive Design: Fully optimized for all screen sizes, ensuring accessibility on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

title: UrbanNestHub
description: UrbanNestHub is a real estate platform designed to connect clients with agents and streamline property transactions. It features a robust role-based system, secure authentication, and Stripe integration for property payments.
features: Role-Based Access: Separate functionalities for Admin, Agent, and Client users.
User Management: Admin can promote users to agents or revoke agent status.
Property Listing Workflow: Agents can create and manage property listings.
Admin Control: Admin reviews and approves or cancels agent-submitted listings.
Listing Cancellation: Agents can cancel their listings, automatically disqualifying the property.
Client Browsing: Clients can view all approved property listings.
Agent Communication: Clients can directly contact agents for inquiries.
Stripe Payment Integration: Secure online payments for property purchases via Stripe.

title: BrandBoulevard
description: BrandBoulevard is an e-commerce platform that showcases premium products from top global brands. It features smooth navigation with React Router, Firebase-powered authentication and database, and a clean modern UI with Tailwind CSS.
features: Diverse Product Listings: Browse a wide selection of products from top fashion and lifestyle brands.
User Authentication: Secure account creation and login for a personalized shopping experience.
Personalized Experience: Enjoy tailored recommendations and streamlined order tracking.
Real-time Updates: Integrated with Firebase for live updates on product availability and order status.
Responsive Design: Optimized for seamless use across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

title: KnowledgeJunctionX
description: KnowledgeJunctionX is an educational and training event management platform that allows educators and organizers to create, manage, and promote events with ease. It features real-time analytics, secure payments, participant engagement tools, and a responsive interface.
features: Event Creation: Easily create and customize educational and training events with detailed information including event type, date, time, and location.
Registration Management: Streamline participant registration with a user-friendly registration form, making it easy to collect and manage attendee data.
Event Promotion: Promote events through integrated social media sharing and email invitations to boost visibility and attendance.
Participant Engagement: Improve attendee experience with interactive features such as live chat, polls, and Q&A sessions.
Real-time Analytics: Monitor event performance with real-time data on registrations, attendance, and engagement.
Secure Payments: Allow secure online payments for paid events, ensuring a smooth and safe transaction process.
Responsive Design: Fully responsive layout accessible across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
